items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 August 2026 9:45pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 27 August 2026 at 9:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure to the southwest of Britain, with associated troughs drifting northwards.


##Wind##

East or Northeast 3 or 4, becoming Cyclonic 2 to 4 tonight. Settling West or Northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, then backing west or southwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, turning heavy at times, then becoming fair later tomorrow morning or early afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5, becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle spreading from the south through Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
